title: Mix and Go Competent Cells
author: Ben Kuipers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jnhkme

steps.title: Prepare 1X Buffers
steps.instruction: Dilute 2X stock solutions to 1X using Dilution Buffer and keep them ice cold (stable for 2 days at 0-25°C).

substeps.instruction: To prepare 5 ml of 1X Wash Buffer: Mix 2.5 ml Dilution Buffer and 2.5 ml of 2X Stock Wash Buffer.
To prepare 5 ml of 1X Competent Buffer: Mix 2.5 ml Dilution Buffer and 2.5 ml of 2X Stock Competent Buffer.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 ml ZymoBroth™ or SOB medium in a 500 ml culture flask using 0.5 ml of fresh, overnight E. coli culture grown in LB.

substeps.instruction: Shake culture vigorously (150 - 250 rpm) at the appropriate temperature until the OD600nm reaches 0.4 - 0.6.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Perform all subsequent steps on ice or at 0-4°C.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the culture to ice for 10 minutes.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 3,000 - 3,700 rpm (1,600 - 2,500 x g) for 10 minutes at 0 - 4°C.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet using ice-cold 1X Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cells gently in 5 ml ice-cold 1X Wash Buffer.
Re-pellet the cells by centrifugation (as described in the harvest step).

steps.title: Resuspend in Competent Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the final cell suspension in ice-cold 1X Competent Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend the cells in 5 ml ice-cold 1X Competent Buffer.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store
steps.instruction: Dispense the cell suspension into sterile microcentrifuge tubes on ice.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 0.1-0.2 ml of the cell suspension per tube.
Use immediately for transformation or store below -70°C.
